narrative.overview: An orderly service counter translated into a task interface: clear labels, dependable spacing, and immediate feedback.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: A saturated color communicates an action, selection, or state.

dos: Label simulated answers and registration actions as demo data.
Keep chat, queue, ticket, and staff states visible in plain language.
donts: Add decorative gradients, fake metrics, emoji icons, or nested cards.
